name: Project context: invariant spec attached to the Security Reviewer is visible as injected in its run trace
description: AC-35 headline flow (deterministic half — see docs/plans/project-context.md R-8). agent-browser has no LLM, so the flow asserts INJECTION VISIBILITY, not finding content: the seeded specs/architecture.md invariant is attached to the Security Reviewer (agents.attached_doc_paths + a real file in the demo clone working tree), and the seeded Security run's trace mirrors the run executor's injection. Steps: (1) agents → Security Reviewer editor → Context tab shows the attached architecture.md; (2) PR #482 → Agent runs tab → open the newest (Security) run's trace → 'Specs read' lists specs/architecture.md; (3) expand Prompt assembly → the 'Project context — attached specs (untrusted)' block contains the invariant text. The grounded-finding half of AC-35 lives in the hermetic server test (project-context-injection.test.ts) with a MockLLMProvider. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (hermetic runner / e2e-web.yml).
